quizName: DMV Practice Test #4 25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: Riding gloves should be made of which material for the best protection?
questions.explanation: Gloves should be made of leather or another durable material to protect your hands.

questions.question: For motorcycle operators, helmets are:

options.text: Required only for operators with a license for two years or less
Required only for operators who received a traffic ticket in the last two years

questions.explanation: In North Carolina, all operators and passengers must wear helmets when riding motorcycles. Helmets must meet DOT standards.

questions.question: The best lane position is the one that:

options.text: Allows you to draft off other vehicles
Allows other motorists to see you
Places you in other vehicles' blind spots

questions.correctAnswerText: Allows other motorists to see you
questions.explanation: Choose a lane position where other drivers can see you. This helps you see others and be seen. It also helps you avoid wind blasts, blind spots, and road hazards. A good position discourages other drivers from sharing your lane and gives you an escape route if needed.

questions.question: When checking tire pressure, you should:
questions.explanation: Always use a tire gauge to check pressure before every ride. A tire can look fine even if it is under-inflated, so you cannot rely on sight alone.

questions.question: When riding with a passenger, you should:

options.text: Squeeze into smaller gaps in traffic

questions.explanation: A passenger adds weight, which affects how your motorcycle handles. Expect slower acceleration, slower turning, and longer stopping distances. Ride slower, start slowing sooner, keep a larger space cushion, and wait for bigger gaps when merging or crossing traffic.

questions.question: Common drugs like cold tablets:

options.text: Can affect your ability to safely operate your motorcycle
Usually won't affect your ability to safely operate your motorcycle
Pose no risk to your operating ability
Are always safe to take before riding because they are sold over-the-counter

questions.correctAnswerText: Can affect your ability to safely operate your motorcycle
questions.explanation: Almost all drugs, including over-the-counter medications, can impact your ability to ride safely. Learn the side effects of any drug before taking it and riding.

questions.question: A motorcycle fits you properly if:

options.text: You can touch your feet to the ground while seated
You can reach the controls by stretching
The handlebars go over your head
Your feet cannot rest on the foot pegs

questions.correctAnswerText: You can touch your feet to the ground while seated
questions.explanation: A motorcycle fits you if your feet can reach the ground while seated. You should also be able to easily reach and operate the controls.

questions.question: Waiting one hour to ride after having one drink:

options.text: Guarantees you cannot be arrested for drinking and riding
Guarantees your riding skills will not be affected
Should be fine as long as you ride slowly
May not fully remove alcohol from your body

questions.correctAnswerText: May not fully remove alcohol from your body
questions.explanation: On average, your body eliminates one drink per hour. The time needed to lower your blood alcohol level varies by person. It is safest not to operate any vehicle after drinking any amount of alcohol.

questions.question: Riding gloves are often:
questions.explanation: Motorcycle riding gloves are usually made of leather. They improve your grip and protect your hands and fingers.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Not wear a jacket if it is warm
Always wear a jacket, even in warm weather

questions.correctAnswerText: Always wear a jacket, even in warm weather
questions.explanation: Always wear a long-sleeved jacket made of appropriate material when riding, even in warm weather. A jacket helps prevent dehydration. Also wear long pants and tuck in shoelaces so they do not catch on the motorcycle.

questions.question: What color are warning signs with black lettering or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They tell drivers about dangerous road conditions ahead.

questions.question: Most motorcycle crashes happen during daylight hours. What should you do?

options.text: Wear bright clothing all the time.
Ride on the shoulder and stay out of traffic.
Wear dark clothing all the time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear bright clothing all the time.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day. Always wear bright clothing when riding so other drivers can see you, even during daylight.

questions.question: If you wait one hour per alcoholic drink before riding, what happens?

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and riding.
Your skills will not be affected.
You will be fine as long as you ride slowly.

questions.explanation: Your body eliminates about one drink per hour. But alcohol can still build up in your system and affect your riding ability, even if you follow this rule.

questions.question: How do you make the shortest and safest stops on a motorcycle?

options.text: By using only the rear brake.
By using only the front brake.
By allowing the front tire to lock up.
By using both the front and rear brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: By using both the front and rear brakes.
questions.explanation: Use both the front and rear brakes together in a smooth way. Do not lock up either tire.

questions.question: What helmet gives you the most protection?
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) standards. It should fit snugly all the way around your head.

questions.question: What are intersections usually like for motorcycle riders?

options.text: Safe since there is so much traffic there.

questions.explanation: Intersections are dangerous because many accidents happen there. Other drivers may turn in front of you or not see you.

questions.question: Your friend has been drinking and wants to ride their motorcycle. What should you do?

options.text: Encourage them to take less-crowded roads.
Encourage friends to talk them out of riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Encourage friends to talk them out of riding.
questions.explanation: Never allow someone who has been drinking to ride. Get your friends to help convince them not to ride. Use peer pressure to stop them.

questions.question: What should you do to prevent injury when riding on a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: Slow down on slippery surfaces. Sudden moves can make your motorcycle skid. Do not ride on the shoulder to avoid slippery roads.

questions.question: When does alcohol start to impair your riding ability?

options.text: Begins at about half of the legal limit.
Occurs only if you have had multiple drinks.

questions.explanation: Even one drink can affect your ability to ride safely. You can be impaired before you reach the legal limit. Never drink before riding.

questions.question: What happens if your motorcycle's chain or belt breaks?

options.text: Experience a sudden increase in power to the rear wheel.
Experience a sudden loss of power to the rear wheel.
Experience a sudden loss of power to the front wheel.
Experience a sudden increase in power to the front wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Experience a sudden loss of power to the rear wheel.
questions.explanation: If your chain or belt breaks, the rear wheel loses power immediately.

questions.question: To reduce your chance of a crash, you should:

options.text: Keep your intentions hidden from other drivers.
Always stay within one foot of another vehicle.

questions.explanation: To reduce crash risk, other drivers must see you. Use your signals and brake light. Position your motorcycle clearly in your lane. Keep space around your motorcycle. Always watch the road ahead, behind, and to the sides.

questions.question: A motorcyclist should constantly look ahead for:
questions.explanation: Look ahead constantly. Watch for changes in traffic, hazards on the road, and ways to escape danger. Be ready to react quickly to anything that changes.

questions.question: You can become more visible by:

options.text: Adding extra lights to your motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Adding extra lights to your motorcycle.
questions.explanation: To be more visible, wear bright colors or reflective clothing. Add extra lights to your motorcycle. Use your turn signals. Flash your brake light when needed. These actions help other drivers see you.

questions.question: The best way to handle a tailgater is to:

options.text: Change lanes and let them pass.
Use your horn and make obscene gestures.
Speed up to create distance between you and them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Change lanes and let the tailgater pass. Speeding up will only make them tailgate faster, making it more dangerous.

questions.question: The front brake is:

options.text: Only for use if the rear brake fails.

questions.explanation: The front brake is safe when used correctly. It is more powerful than the rear brake and provides at least three-quarters of your stopping power.
